prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory registry for scoped metadata tags.

Expose a cloneable `TagRegistry`, and `RegistryError` with `InvalidName(String)`, `UnknownScope(String)`, and `Duplicate(String)` variants. Provide:
- `TagRegistry::new() -> Self`
- `register_scope(&mut self, scope: &str) -> Result<(), RegistryError>`
- `register_tag(&mut self, scope: &str, tag: &str) -> Result<(), RegistryError>`
- `register_batch(&mut self, enabled: bool, entries: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), RegistryError>`
- `tags(&self) -> Vec<String>`

A valid name begins with an ASCII letter or underscore and continues with ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. Empty or non-ASCII names are invalid. Scopes must be registered before their tags. Re-registering a scope or a tag is a duplicate error. Duplicate tag errors contain `scope::tag`.

When `enabled` is false, `register_batch` must return success without inspecting or changing the entries. When true, it registers entries in slice order. The whole batch is atomic: any error leaves the registry exactly unchanged, including when an earlier entry was valid. `tags` returns all `scope::tag` strings in lexicographic order. Empty registries and empty batches are valid.

Provide a complete, standard-library-only `solution.rs` without `main`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
